selected_gaps.gap: Additive; frontier sites iasa and plume_joint, with orthogonal calibration as an estimand warning: source separability conditional on a declared transport/background class does not establish that this class excludes wrong-source explanations for physically valid reasons. The needed outcome is a source-location claim whose identifying restrictions have testable implications beyond fitting the same gas response, using only the information actually available online — stakes: inventory diagnostics or calibration constraints can produce a unique, precise model-dependent answer while leaving the physical leak location unestablished, undermining both field decisions and the main scientific claim.
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: Encode verified geometry, transport conservation/positivity and sensor causality into a candidate-independent admissible history family O; audit-and-pivot then removes or weakens each proposed identifying restriction on O and asks which existing non-gas observations can falsify that restriction, producing a source estimator whose conditional scope is explicit. The second move operates on the exact family consumed by the estimator, rather than adding a separate diagnostic paper: restrictions justified only by the source fit cannot be promoted to physical identification.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This construction gap is load-bearing because a unique posterior under an arbitrarily chosen history class is not yet an estimate of the physical leak, and the intake explicitly permits innovation in independently validated model structure. Structural encoding must therefore supply a buildable causal history family with testable restrictions, while the chained audit prevents the construction from collapsing to the occupied ancestors of ordinary marginalization, profile likelihood, blind deconvolution, orthogonal calibration or generic set-membership reporting; if no domain-specific identifying restriction survives, Phase 2.2 must declare the method application-grade or its premise unqualified instead of claiming a cure.

deliverable_coverage: method — the anchor's structural_prior_encoding owns the runnable causal source-history model and estimator; the chained assumption_audit_and_pivot makes its identifying restrictions and independently testable implications part of that same construction.

user_direction_disposition.user_wanted: Contributions may instead be in identifiable, independently validated causal model structure; do not demand beating Bayes under the identical correct model.
user_direction_disposition.chosen: A causal physical history model whose source-identifying restrictions are exposed to existing observable checks, with ordinary Bayes retained as the equal-model computational baseline.

assumption_audit_and_pivot.selection_note: untested lane — differentiation_from_lit must substantively defend the choice; auditing a model assumption alone does not create identifying information

deferred_gaps.gap: Additive; frontier sites dgse and rank: for a moving sensor with memory, a gas sample is generated by exposure along a history, and distinct location/strength/transport histories can induce the same complete sampled record even though their instantaneous fields or fixed-nuisance responses differ. The retrieved mobile methods do not establish the conditions under which the existing joint history distinguishes those locations when the environmental plume predates sensor startup — stakes: the user's UAV can interpret delayed peaks or persistent residual gas as current spatial evidence, concentrating belief at a wrong source and spending its limited search time there.
deferred_gaps.reason: Fails removal test as a separate contribution: persistent initial plume and complete sensor/transport histories are mandatory inputs to the anchor construction, but a second general identifiability theorem would need additional machinery; the anchor stands without that separate deliverable.

deferred_gaps.gap: Subtractive; frontier sites dgse and rank, shared ancestor steady: whether the steady-field summary assumed by these two indoor source-inference branches is sufficient for source identification when source age, environmental initial concentration and sensor history are not known. This is a question about that branch's inherited assumption, not a claim that every retrieved paper assumes steady state — stakes: apparent gains from a physically structured estimator may depend on an unexamined reduction of the data-generating process, preventing their interpretation as evidence for physical source identification in the user's transient setting.
deferred_gaps.reason: Fails removal test — anchor stands without a separate sufficiency study of the steady-field branch; the no-zero-initial-plume and no-arbitrary-warm-up constraints already bind its model construction.
